create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 joint functional-equation double-Poisson self-return with residue completion
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), y=floor(J), H=floor(yX^(-1/4))=sqrt(J)+O(1), and 1<<L<<H. Retain the complete literal hard-TOP t=1 scalar and the exact Round-168 disjoint-cardinal interpolant B. The residual Euler coefficients have the exact odd-prime local table (0,0):1, (2,0):-1, (0,2):-1, (1,1):-chi_4(p), (2,1):1, (1,2):chi_4(p), with p=2 table (0,0):1,(0,2):-1, and satisfy g(Q,R)=chi_4(Q) sum_([u^2,c]=Q,[v^2,c]=R;u,c odd) mu(u)mu(v)mu(c). Their shifted-line absolute mass is asymp eta^(-3), while sum |g(Q,R)|/(QR) converges. The completed zeta and chi_4 functional equations have respectively even and odd gamma parity, root number one, and yield the exact cosine and sine kernels. For the canonical finite physical block set, S_(L,1)=(i/2) sum_(Q,R)^phys g(Q,R)/(QR) sum_(k odd)chi_4(k) sum_l B_tilde(k/(4Q),l/R). If Z_phys is its finite l=0 mode and R_zeta is the full Round-168 Mellin residue, then E_0=Z_phys-R_zeta with Z_phys,R_zeta,E_0<<L^2/J; the finite zero mode is not literally the full residue. Consequently I_eta=E_0+(i/2)sum_(Q,R)^phys g(Q,R)/(QR)sum_(k odd)chi_4(k)sum_(l!=0)B_tilde(k/(4Q),l/R). The only positive interior stationary branch has kl=XQR and Ql<=Rk<=4Ql. Substitution of the collapsed coefficient law returns coefficientwise to the accepted Round-162 Mobius character-Poisson/ordinary-Poisson family, including p=2. On a favorable recombined smooth block the inherited positive capacity is sqrt(JL)X^epsilon, with unpaid ratio H/L+O(L^(-1)); the exact cardinal array has no proved global smooth recombination. Thus bare joint functional equations and the named positive or audited source placements do not prove the open signed aggregate. This is a scoped self-return reduction, not a lower bound or universal no-go. No polynomial t=1 target, parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent is proved.

The exact transform exposes but does not estimate the signed nonzero-frequency aggregate; the rank-one radial phase is constant at kl=XQR.
The favorable smooth-interior capacity is sqrt(JL)X^epsilon with H/L deficit, and the exact O(L^2)-cell cardinal array has no proved length-L radial recombination.

The audited theorems require integral additive shifts or Kloosterman data, fixed levels/cusps or controlled moving levels, smooth weights, complete spectra, and positive norms; no exact target-safe map preserves the signed g(Q,R)/(QR) aggregate.
The result is a no-go only for bare dualization, named positive placements, and the dated audited source set. A bespoke signed joint-aggregate theorem remains possible.

The signed aggregate, full polynomial t=1 scalar and residual, other hard-TOP channels, BAL, UNBAL, both M1 routes, endpoint uniformity, M9, both bridges, the quarter theorem, and both exponent ledgers remain open or unchanged.
